content: Fastify trustProxy (already wired in this codebase via BuildAppOptions.trustProxy / TRUST_PROXY env, Phase 5) makes request.ip resolve through X-Forwarded-For via the 'proxy-addr' package once enabled — request.ip becomes the real client IP instead of the proxy's socket address. Fastify docs explicitly warn request.ip/request.ips are untrusted-input-shaped even with trustProxy on (a misconfigured or absent proxy allow-list still lets a client spoof X-Forwarded-For) - matches this project's existing TRUST_PROXY opt-in-only stance (fail-safe default false).
